purpose: Continue portfolio lane A by taking the real research artifact already produced by the shared runtime, render it in a browser-capable environment, preserve a screenshot, and verify the delivered artifact without redoing research.

steps.command: set -euo pipefail; BROWSER="$(command -v google-chrome || command -v chromium || command -v chromium-browser || true)"; test -n "$BROWSER" || { echo NO_BROWSER_BINARY >&2; exit 42; }; "$BROWSER" --headless --no-sandbox --disable-gpu --window-size=1200,800 --screenshot=canonical/astra_runtime/evidence/research_artifact_001.png "file://$PWD/canonical/astra_runtime/evidence/research_artifact_001.html"; test -s canonical/astra_runtime/evidence/research_artifact_001.png

set -euo pipefail; python - <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('canonical/astra_runtime/evidence/research_artifact_001.png')
out={'artifact':'canonical/astra_runtime/evidence/research_artifact_001.html','screenshot':str(p),'screenshot_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'screenshot_bytes':p.stat().st_size}
pathlib.Path('canonical/astra_runtime/evidence/research_artifact_001_browser_receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n')
PY
